title: Wahhaman
titleNative: ワッハマン
synopsis: Wahhaman is a special robot soldier built ten thousand years ago by the Atlanteans. Found and dug up in present-day Toukyou, he doesn't remember anything, due to a nasty knock to the head he received at some point. People tend to mistake Wahhaman, who is unable to speak except for laughing when going into battle, for someone or something that they are looking for in their own lives. Later volumes of Wahhaman are more action and humour based and focus around the battles between Wahhaman and an organisation led by a mysterious man. The disfigured man, who has a long time grudge against Wahhaman, uses a number of transforming robots to capture Wahhaman, but they always fail. (source : http://users.skynet.be/mangaguide/au174.html)

If there's one silver lining, he's not the only one—and his comrade could be the girl of his dreams?! (Source: Yen Press)

synopsis: Despite her hidden genius, Avril has lived a life of misery, constantly belittled as useless by her own family. When she is forced to substitute for her wicked step-sister in a marriage to a supposedly lecherous, old duke, Avril expects the worst. But surprisingly, Duke Dylan is actually a breathtakingly handsome young man. He offers her a deal: act as his villainess wife for three years, and then they will divorce. For Avril, this contract is a golden ticket to her ultimate freedom. But as she enthusiastically embraces her new evil persona, her mysterious charm leaves the duke and his household completely bewildered and entirely enchanted. (Source: Kadokawa)

title: Tokusatsu Gagaga
titleNative: トクサツガガガ
synopsis: Nakamura Kano is an OL (office lady) with a secret… she’s a “Toku Otaku,” a tokusatsu otaku who is obsessed with live action dramas of heroes, monsters and robots. She thinks they’re “JUST TOO COOL!” She’s so obsessed that she skips out on drinking with colleagues to watch it on TV and collects the DVDs, books and figurines. She lives her life by the code of the tokusatsu heroes, and constantly imagines them to help her through difficult situations. But this isn’t easy when all of her co-workers think that people who like anime and other childish things are weird, and they keep trying to make her socialize. Notes: Nominated to the 21st Annual Tezuka Osamu Cultural Prize.

synopsis: Genichi Tomita, a newspaper reporter, has just been transferred to a rural town. While house-hunting, he arranges to rent a vacant house through a referral from a former colleague back in Tokyo. But when he arrives at the address he was given, he finds nothing but a dilapidated, rundown house. As Genichi stands there at a loss, a gyaru dressed in farm work clothes suddenly appears before him — Shuri Nakazato. A comfortable slow-life rom-com begins, as our hero gets swept along by a gyaru who's absolutely obsessed with farming!!
